The staging deploy is not healthy. Image `api:7f3c2e1` was built, pushed, and set on `deployment/api`, but `/healthz` was still returning 503 when the 60s healthcheck timed out.

I haven't confirmed whether the rollout finished, whether the new pods are crash-looping or just slow to start, or whether the old pods are still serving. The next step is `kubectl rollout status deployment/api` plus a look at pod status and logs. Should I investigate, or roll back with `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api` first?
